prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original SOULMONSTERS environment concept panorama of ALTO DA SERRA, eighth championship neighborhood in present-day Kronasta. Wide 16:9 high three-quarter architectural overview, distinct inviting contemporary upland town with coherent terrain and memorable silhouettes. CLEAN economical 2D MANGA ink, flat local color masses and one hard cel shadow per material, grouped vegetation, sparse surface marks. No photorealism, painterly textures or 3D rendering. A modern inhabited town adapted to cold wind, NOT rustic alpine chalet village, medieval city or tropical shacks.
Three connected neighborhood terraces cut into one continuous grounded mountain slope. Foreground lower arrival street from mountain trail, sheltered glass bus stop, public map totem with abstract symbols only, cream/plum corner bakery-tea shop with a sculpted low L-shaped canopy creating wind-protected entry courtyard, warm amber interior glimpse and two small tables. A few small separate modern houses with thick ivory insulated walls, slate/navy low asymmetric metal roofs, recessed doors, broad windbreak glazing and enclosed balconies, sage/plum accents, heat-pump units and solar panels. Distinct footprints with gardens of low alpine shrubs, no houses stuck together.
Middle terrace: shared residential square with long low glazed community conservatory/winter garden under a gently ridged pale roof, useful repair/supply shop and quiet bench sheltered behind transparent wind screens. Broad main pedestrian stair with TWO flights and real intermediate landing connects lower and middle terrace; a separate long supported sloped path runs along contour to same upper landing. Street for small contemporary delivery van follows outside contour at sensible slope, never drives up pedestrian stairs.
Upper terrace RIGHT: champion DONA NEVE's modest open-air public DUEL COURT on firm land, two tamer positions, small camera and scoreboard, sheltered spectator seats with navy metal roof and transparent windbreak on exposed side. Court is clear and usable under open sky, not a rooftop and not identical to a giant stadium. Clearly visible ramp and staircase mouths open through retaining walls with no wall crossing paths, solid continuous slopes below terraces.
Distinct skyline landmark at upper LEFT separate from court: original WIND TOWER, contemporary civic instrument tower in cream concrete and navy metal with FOUR differently oriented large curved vane panels surrounding an OPEN central spindle and circular maintenance deck, clean bold silhouette, small electrical service annex at base, no fantasy crystal or arbitrary huge turbine farm. The tower has ancient subtle diamond line-knot symbol in its base, linking contemporary engineering to ancestral wind lore without depicting any story event. Spacious accessible precinct for a later narrative gathering, no soul rays, monster designs or spoilers. Vane forms must be practical and readable, not giant decorative kites pasted to facade.
Depth reward: far valley, Kronasta city and coastal water visible below left, distant blue-grey Serra pinnacles at right. Cold clear daylight with warm sun, small residual snow ONLY in far shaded rock crevices, town itself dry and lived-in. Sparse hardy trees shaped by wind, planted pockets and sage/ochre grasses, no forest border. Palette warm ivory, muted plum, sage, navy/slate, amber windows and pale cyan sky. Roof gutters and downspouts, handrails and foundations coherent. Contemporary technology integrated discretely. A handful of ordinary small pedestrians for scale, no closeup named characters or creatures. Breathing room and calm paving, meaningful architectural details instead of noisy textures. No labels, text, logos, watermark, HUD, straw roofs, wooden huts, castles, church spires or floating terrain.
